page.overview:
Who is Benedict McCartney?

Benedict McCartney (born as Beatrice McCartney, October 28, 2003) is the youngest child of Paul McCartney. Benedict was born out of Paul McCartney’s marriage with businesswoman and activist Heather Mills.

Being the child of a world-renowned musician, Benedict learned to play the saxophone at a very young age. However, it is not quite known if he would follow in his famous father’s footsteps, as he hardly seem interested in hogging the limelight.

Benedict’s mother Heather Mills once mentioned that he would like to pursue a career as a marine biologist. Category:People Category:Beatle Relatives Category:The Beatles' Children
